document.abstract: Made up of the chairs, co-chairs and/or vice-chairs of various committees, subcommittees and working groups.

authors.bio: Curtis Clark, ASC, is chair of the ASC Motion Imaging Technology Council.
authors.name: Curtis Clark

authors.bio: Michael Goi, ASC, ISC is a director, cinematographer and producer.
authors.name: Michael Goi

authors.bio: Jay Holben is an independent producer and director in Los Angeles, CA.
authors.name: Jay Holben

authors.bio: David Reisner is an entertainment, technology, business consultant, the vice-founder and the Vice-Chair of ASC MITC, and a Lead Designer of Academy, EMMY, HPA Award-winning ASC CDL and the StEM Standard Evaluation Material.
authors.name: David Reisner

authors.bio: Christopher Probst, ASC, is a cinematographer and a member of ASC.
authors.name: Christopher Probst

authors.bio: Tim Kang is a Los Angeles-based cinematographer. music video, and documentary projects.
authors.name: Tim Kang

authors.bio: Greg Ciaccio, Senior Director post-production, original content and image capture at IMAX.
authors.name: Greg Ciaccio

authors.bio: Joshua Pines oversees imaging and color science at pictureshop, has always thought that computers could be a useful tool in making movies better, and he still hopes that one day this may come true.
authors.name: Joshua Pines

authors.bio: Lou Levinson currently works at Apple in the San Francisco Bay Area. He is a long-time Associate Member of the ASC, the Vice-Chair of the MITC Digital Intermediate Committee, and a Member of the ASC Technology Committee since its inception.
authors.name: Lou Levinson

authors.bio: Annie Chang is Vice President Creative Technology at Universal Pictures.
authors.name: Annie Chang

authors.bio: Jesse Korosi is the Manager, Production Technology Solutions at Netflix, an Associate Member at the ASC.
authors.name: Jesse Korosi

authors.bio: Patrick Renner is a specialist in designing and developing media management and video processing applications for production and post-production workflows.
authors.name: Patrick Renner

authors.bio: David Hall Senior Manager, Production Technology at Netflix.
authors.name: David Hall

authors.bio: Joachim Zell is a consultant on production and post-production workflows, ACES and Imaging Science.
authors.name: Joachim Zell

authors.bio: Gary Mandle is CEO at Outtahand Industries.
authors.name: Gary Mandle

authors.bio: Gary Demos has been a pioneer in the development of computer-generated images and digital image processing for use in motion pictures.
authors.name: Gary Demos

authors.bio: Pete Ludé serves as chief technology officer of Mis-sion Rock Digital, a San Fran-cisco-based engineering firm.
authors.name: Pete Ludé

authors.bio: Michael Zink is vice president of emerging & creative technologies at Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD). He is also Education Vice President at SMPTE.
authors.name: Michael Zink
